compatibility_notes: The resumed blind-SR search logic and PySR configuration are unchanged; the runner change is strict atomic JSON serialization.
Twenty-five of the first 36 reports contain non-standard NaN only in failed secondary GMM-MI diagnostic fields; their MSE fields and selected winners are finite and unchanged.
Existing result artifacts were not edited or replaced. The final selection manifest hashes every report and this provenance file.
Amendment A1 removed non-selecting T0 MI diagnostics from new MSE tasks; A2 then removed optional T2 reconstruction/full-residual MI while retaining the required known-f2 absorption MI test.

The remaining 129 searches, 12 controls and all three consolidation stages ran on a Lightning AI free-plan CPU Studio; see lightning_execution for the environment, per-task thread attribution and recorded deviations.

transfer_and_gate.method: tar over ssh from CSD3, repository including .git so the selection manifest could record a real git_revision
transfer_and_gate.gate_result: verify_mse_one_stage_state.py --compare: every carried input, source and existing report byte-identical to CSD3

execution.orchestration: scripts/run_mse_one_stage_pool.py, persistent Julia/PySR workers; no scheduler
execution.task_identity: rebuilt from the Slurm launchers' PRINT_MATRIX tables; per-task-id command parity asserted in tests/test_mse_one_stage_lightning.py
execution.interruption: Lightning stopped the Studio mid-run; SIGTERM was caught, in-flight tasks finished, the pool exited cleanly and resumed on a new VM with the persistent disk intact

confirm.note: ran once end to end; no relaunch and no partial artifacts

recorded_deviations: Julia thread count differs from the 16 threads used for the first 36 CSD3 reports; per-task attribution is given above. Search volume (200 iterations x 15 populations), operators, seeds and maxsize ladder are unchanged.
Process model: many fits inside one persistent Julia/PySR process instead of one process per task. Each task still constructs a fresh PySRRegressor with its own output_directory and run_id.

Both selection manifests record git_dirty=true. The sole cause was one untracked provenance artifact (experiments/mse_one_stage_state_lightning.json, committed afterwards); no tracked file was modified. The manifests were left immutable rather than re-cut, since re-cutting a frozen selection artifact is what that guard exists to prevent.
code_fixes_during_execution: bootstrap: `uv venv` without --seed produces a venv with no pip, which would have failed the install step on a fresh machine

both consolidation launchers mis-parsed their arguments: a literal '}' inside ${1:?...} closes the parameter expansion early, so MODE arrived as 'select <run-name>}'. hpc/slurm_mse_one_stage_consolidate.sh carried the identical defect and had never been exercised because CSD3 ran out of allowance before consolidation.
lightning_execution.known_caveat: src/cmb_lcdm_sr/mi.py calls EstimateMI().fit_estimate() without an explicit random_state. Subsampling and the 39 permutation seeds are deterministic, but a re-run of confirm need not reproduce MI values bit-identically. Not exercised here: confirm ran once.
